rates.quote: but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of royalties.

notes: Art. 28(2): EIF on receipt of the later notification (25 Jan 2010); effective for income earned at/after the beginning of the calendar year following the year of legal effect -> 1 Jan 2011 (State Tax Service list); Protocol para. 2: calendar year begins 21 March in Iran (so from 21 Mar 2011 in Iran). Single dividend rate. Art. 11(4): interest derived by the Government, other governmental institutions, Central Bank and banks wholly owned by the other State's Government exempt at source. Royalty definition includes equipment rental. No PPT/LOB; not MLI-covered.
